title: Ag2Se-Based thermoelectric materials and devices: progress, challenges, and perspectives
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01371F, Review Article
Jia-Ming Lyu, Li Zhang, Yan-Ling Yang, Jian-Feng Zhu, Xiao-Lei Shi, Zhi-Gang Chen
Ag2Se is a promising n-type thermoelectric material for near-room-temperature energy harvesting and solid-state cooling due to its high carrier mobility, low lattice thermal conductivity, scalable synthesis, and relatively low cost.
